headline: Solar Stock: renewable energy company receives ₹455 crore order, will install solar panels on rooftops of 1 lakh homes
summary: GK Energy received a solar order of ₹454.5 crore from a state government electricity distribution company. The company will install 100 MW of rooftop solar systems on 1 lakh homes, and its profit rose 54% in the June quarter.
why: Large government-linked orders add to order books for renewable energy contractors, and rooftop solar programmes are part of India's push for clean power capacity.
